authority.claim_boundary: Stage P is a reviewed prospective design and public deterministic bank freeze; it is not empirical evidence.

claims.distillation_claim_ceiling: The registered target checkpoint effect is stronger than both fixed controls and is associated with the total post-training/distillation-related checkpoint change.
forbidden_claims: natural-language chain of thought was observed
a particular distillation example caused the mechanism
the result generalizes beyond both registered finite-state families
claims.jspace_claim_gate: A Study 2 J-space statement additionally requires STUDY2_JLENS_VALIDATED; the J-lens axis cannot promote or demote the lens-independent internal-computation axis.
claims.operational_claim_ceiling: The target checkpoint uses a causally load-bearing intermediate variable to solve fresh compositional tasks under a controlled no-generated-trace interface.

composite_precedence: Gate A failure closes protocol v1 before B-C and produces no scientific composite state.
Operationally incomplete or integrity-failed required opened pack -> STUDY2_RESULT_NOT_ESTIMABLE.
Two-family internal support plus stronger-than-both comparison -> STUDY2_DISTILLATION_ASSOCIATED_CAUSAL_INTERNAL_REASONING_SUPPORTED.
Two-family internal support without stronger-than-both comparison -> STUDY2_CAUSAL_INTERNAL_REASONING_SUPPORTED_WITHOUT_DISTILLATION_ATTRIBUTION.
At least one compositional NT_PASS but no internally supported family -> STUDY2_BEHAVIOR_ONLY_WITHOUT_CAUSAL_SUPPORT.
No compositional NT_PASS and PT_SUPPORT in both families -> STUDY2_EXTERNAL_TRACE_DEPENDENCE_ONLY.
No compositional NT_PASS and PT_SUPPORT in exactly one family -> STUDY2_EXTERNAL_TRACE_SUPPORT_ONE_FAMILY_ONLY.
No compositional NT_PASS or PT_SUPPORT and at least one depth-1 NT_PASS -> STUDY2_NO_COMPOSITIONAL_BEHAVIORAL_SUPPORT.
No target NT_PASS at any depth and no PT_SUPPORT -> STUDY2_TASK_INTERFACE_UNQUALIFIED.

distillation_axis.contradicted: A complete pack has both controls exceed target aggregate behavior and causal effects with reverse-direction lower95 >0.
distillation_axis.not_distinguished: Target internal computation is supported but one or both prospective checkpoint comparisons fail to exclude zero.
distillation_axis.not_estimable: Target internal computation is unsupported or the comparative pack is operationally incomplete.
distillation_axis.stronger_than_both: Target internal computation is supported; paired lower95 target-minus-each-control aggregate NT accuracy >0; in each family paired lower95 target-minus-each-control PATCH_RECOMBINATION >0; every hard control passes.

internal_axis.behavior_only: At least one compositional target NT_PASS exists but neither family passes the complete internal gate after opened finite mechanistic packs finish.
internal_axis.no_compositional_support: No compositional NT_PASS and no PT_SUPPORT, with at least one depth-1 NT_PASS.
internal_axis.not_estimable: A required opened pack is operationally incomplete, identity-mismatched, non-finite, or integrity-failed.
internal_axis.supported: Both families have a selected depth, target NT_PASS, target PATCH_PASS, and target PROBE_PASS.
internal_axis.supported_one_family: Exactly one family passes the complete internal gate and is explicitly non-generalized.

execution_reliability.scope: non-scientific contract for later authorized T/B/M execution

family_pass_requires: target restricted-option correct count is at least 43
feasibility_gate.on_pass: seal development and Gate A manifest-last; B-C still requires separate authority
feasibility_gate.overall_pass: both families pass; no pooling, depth fallback, or control-model rescue
feasibility_gate.placement: after Stage T and B-D implementation validation; before any B-C object is opened

control_interpretation.instruction_control: The same-family instruction checkpoint reduces the alternative that a target advantage is generic instruction following or post-training.
control_interpretation.joint_ceiling: Only a prospective target advantage over both controls can support checkpoint-level distillation association; neither control identifies a causal training sample, teacher trace, objective, or loss component.
control_interpretation.lineage_base: The named source checkpoint family controls for pre-distillation base capability but is not instruction tuned.

limitations: Forced-choice logits measure controlled discriminative preference, not spontaneous natural-language behavior.
Synthetic finite-state tasks do not establish broad mathematical, factual, agentic, or real-world reasoning.
Three final checkpoints do not isolate the causal contribution of individual distillation examples or objectives.
The base and instruction controls differ in post-training and possibly tokenizer or config details.
Supplied PT, WT, and ST traces are controlled external traces, not natural self-generated chain of thought.
Activation patching can establish causal influence but not a complete human-readable algorithm.
Full-residual transfer carries more than one feature, making recombinant and matched controls essential.
Probe decodability alone is not mechanism.
M1200 was fitted on a WikiText proxy and remains unvalidated until the new target-only J-lens axis passes.
Only single-token digit concepts enter the J-lens subaxis.
Public deterministic banks are prospective but not private or researcher-blind.
Any one-family result cannot be generalized across reasoning domains.
No Study 2 outcome modifies Phase 1.0D or retrospectively validates Study 1.
Gate A conditions confirmation opening on target development success and therefore creates disclosed protocol-selection and winner's-curse risk.
The recorded power calculations are marginal component sensitivity; joint power across conjunctive gates is not identified.

nt_pass: restricted accuracy point estimate at least 0.50
paired-bootstrap lower 95% bound of mean correct margin strictly above zero
option and template balance invariants pass

bootstrap.maxima: compute each registered maximum inside every bootstrap replicate before quantiles
bootstrap.quantile: sort finite replicate statistics; use linear interpolation at (n-1)*p for p=0.025 and 0.975
bootstrap.sampling_algorithm: Order units by semantic item ID or pair ID. For replicate r and draw d, hash UTF-8 seed, domain, r, d, and attempt separated by U+001F; interpret SHA-256 as an unsigned big-endian integer; reject values at or above 2^256-(2^256 mod n); select value mod n.
bootstrap.unit_behavior: semantic item ID within family x depth with model/template/arm rows kept paired
bootstrap.unit_mechanism: pair ID after equal averaging over the three frozen-window layers
bootstrap.unit_order: ascending semantic item ID for behavior and ascending pair ID for mechanism

jlens.auc: normalized trapezoidal AUC against log(k), equal family weighting, equal item averaging over the three frozen-window layers
coordinate_controls: five deterministic Gram-matched random direction pairs
jlens.coordinate_swap: swap target M1200 coordinates for m_r and m_d and score the fixed recipient recombinant G_x
jlens.jcausal_pass: lower95(M1200 recombinant G_x minus logit-lens, averaged Gram-matched random, and direct donor-answer-vector effects)>0
jlens.jreadout_pass: lower95(M1200-logit-lens AUC)>0 and lower95(M1200-each averaged label/position control)>0

patching.PATCH_BAND_SPECIFICITY: mean G_x(middle window)-max(mean G_x(early), mean G_x(motor))
patching.PATCH_STRUCTURAL_SPECIFICITY: mean G_x - max(mean G_x(no-op), mean G_x(same-intermediate), mean G_x(same-answer))
patching.patch_pass: All six paired-bootstrap lower 95% bounds are strictly above zero.
patching.position: final input token at registered Answer: position

probe.activation: final Answer: position at center layer of frozen three-layer window
probe.balance: intermediate class and final-answer option have registered class-frequency chance only
probe.pass: lower95(true accuracy-class-frequency chance)>0 and lower95(true accuracy-mean five permuted accuracies)>0

restricted_option.correct_margin: correct-option logit minus best incorrect-option logit
restricted_option.prediction: argmax of the four logits with A, B, C, D tie order only for exact ties

trace.pt_support: At a depth-2/3 cell: PT Wilson lower95 > 0.25, PT point >= 0.50, lower95 TRACE_GAIN > 0, lower95 WRONG_TRACE_PULL > 0, and at depth 3 lower95 SHUFFLE_DAMAGE > 0.

binds: all bank hashes and byte counts

pair_design.control_contrast: Every control G_x retains the primary pair recipient contrast logit(a_x)-logit(a_r); it never substitutes a control donor answer or recombinant.

controls.definition: donor object is exactly the recipient object
donor pre-answer intermediate equals m_r while its semantic identity differs
donor answer equals a_r and donor intermediate differs from m_r
deterministic unrelated same-family/depth/template donor whose intermediate and answer both differ from the recipient
recipient Start: state-symbol UTF-8 byte span; Stage T freezes its per-model token index

primary_constraints: a_d, a_r, and a_x are pairwise distinct
donor and recipient share one four-value option set
donor, recipient, recombinant, and distractor values share one exact value-to-label mapping
donor, recipient, and recombinant labels are pairwise distinct
all tasks within a pair unit share family, depth, template, structural field order, and option mapping

stage_t.eligibility: For all three pinned tokenizers, donor, recipient, and controls have exact equal input length and aligned answer position, with resolvable wrong-position anchor.
stage_t.selection: first 128 eligible candidates separately in each role x family x depth cell

PT.name: partial_correct_trace
PT.trace: programmatically correct pre-final intermediate states in order, excluding final state and option label

ST.name: shuffled_trace
ST.trace: the two PT intermediate states in reverse order with identical token multiset and trace length

WT.name: partial_wrong_trace
WT.required_option: answer implied by continuing from counterfactual
WT.trace: PT byte structure with final supplied intermediate replaced by registered counterfactual

prompt_arms.dr01: Natural-language output, if accidentally emitted later, is diagnostic-only and cannot enter a gate, selection, evidence row, or claim without separate semantic-review authority.

model_generated_cot.reason: Sampling, termination, parsing, and semantic adjudication would reintroduce an unreviewed dependency.

research_question: Does the R1-distilled checkpoint compute and causally use a task-defined intermediate variable during a single forward pass with zero generated reasoning tokens, and is that behavior or mechanism stronger than in both its lineage base checkpoint and a same-family instruction-tuned control?

checklist: Does NT truly contain zero generated or supplied reasoning tokens while measuring a model preference rather than output-format compliance?
Are four-option tokens prospectively verifiable in all three tokenizers without outcome-dependent substitution?
Are task answers, intermediates, distractors, trace arms, and pair counterfactuals mechanically unique and independently reconstructible?
Are development, behavioral confirmation, mechanistic development, and mechanistic candidate confirmation semantically disjoint?
Can any task, model, cell, template, item, pair, layer, position, comparator, or exclusion depend on confirmation, lens, probe, or intervention output, or feasibility output?
Do balance and direct-lookup controls distinguish composition from option priors and single-surface shortcuts?
Does a_x=g_r(m_d), with distinct answer values and shared value-to-label mappings, distinguish intermediate transfer from donor-answer or donor-option-label copying?
Do same-intermediate, same-answer, random-donor, no-op, wrong-position, early-band, and motor-band controls cover the stated alternatives?
Is target-defined development localization fully separated from confirmation and applied unchanged to both controls?
Does the probe test a held-out surface template and avoid final-answer leakage?
Is the target M1200 axis secondary and incapable of selecting or rescuing the lens-independent result?
Do the two controls support only the registered checkpoint-level distillation association, not a stronger training-causal claim?
Are DR-01, Study 1 protected bytes, Phase 1.0D, and all old terminal states preserved?
Are every metric, bootstrap unit, threshold, null, truth-table branch, and output row exactly computable from planned fields, power/sensitivity quantity, feasibility branch, and reliability state?
Can every positive and negative result be reconstructed from a closed row-level pack without semantic interpretation?
review.correction_scope: one consolidation of every FATAL and MATERIAL finding
review.references_required: exact file path and JSON pointer
review.verification_scope: same checklist; only a direct contradiction introduced by the correction may be newly identified

mechanistic_cell.rule: choose depth 3 if target NT_PASS, else depth 2 if target NT_PASS, else none

window.control_mapping: exact normalized depth with round-half-up when a control block count differs
window.score: S(layer)=family-equal mean over pairs of G_x(layer)-max(G_d(layer),G_x(random donor,layer))
window.tie_break: lowest starting layer for exact arithmetic tie

allowed_nonzero_operations: model-free Python bank generation in ACR
stage_machine.purpose: protocol, public deterministic banks, bounded methods review, freeze
pinned model/config/tokenizer identity and token-alignment gate
three-model behavioral development implementation check and fixed Gate A feasibility decision
closed behavioral confirmation and target-defined cell selection
target-only full layer scan and one frozen three-layer window
fixed-window target/control patching, probes, and target-only secondary J-lens axis

balance.candidate_hash_partitions: Each mechanistic cell contains balanced 128-row front and 128-row back SHA-256 partitions so a fully eligible first-128 selection is balanced.
balance.single_field_label_rule: Within each value of template, start, pre-answer intermediate, final state, and final operator, A/B/C/D counts differ by at most one.
balance.state_and_operator_tolerance: maximum count minus minimum count is at most one

families.operator_definition: Each operator is a complete independently sampled permutation over all eight states.
Each operator has f(x)=(a*x+b) mod 10 with a in [1,3,7,9] and b in [0,9].

generator.algorithm: SHA-256 counter mode with rejection randbelow and deterministic rejection sampling

ground_truth.final_state: state after the final queried operator
ground_truth.pre_answer_intermediate: start state at depth 1; penultimate state at depths 2 and 3

task_design.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, split on Unicode whitespace, rejoin with one ASCII space

semantic_identity.hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON plus one LF byte

splits.rendering: one assigned template per semantic item
one assigned template per semantic item

templates.order: definitions, Start/apply query, options, optional supplied trace, Answer:
templates.semantic_equivalence: same primitive task and option mapping as T-B

templates.order: Start/apply query, options, state legend, reverse-ordered definitions, optional supplied trace, Answer:
templates.semantic_equivalence: same primitive task and option mapping as T-A
